name: ig-dm-export-analyzer
description: (beta) Turn an Instagram "Download Your Information" export into a clean, analysable chat corpus — one JSON file per conversation plus a filterable index.json rollup. Repairs Meta's UTF-8-as-Latin-1 mojibake, merges message_N.json pagination, filters strictly by date range and excluded threads, resolves media across split text/media archives, and transcribes voice notes and video audio tracks through a configurable speech-to-text provider (Soniox cloud, local whisper.cpp, or none). Every machine transcription is labeled four independent ways so it can never be mistaken for something the person typed, and a self-consistency verifier reconciles the output against the raw export. Fully config-driven: a new export is a new config file, not a code change.
